TRAFFIC ADVISORY: 1D officers dispatched to the 600 block of North Horners Lane at 3:42 p.m. for the report of a pedestrian struck. 

One adult female pedestrian is being transported to an area hospital with serious injuries. The driver remained on scene.

North Horners Lane is closed between Lincoln Avenue and Frederick Avenue. 

Drivers are encouraged to expect delays and seek an alternate route.

#MCPNews #MCPD #RoadClosure

data.raw_text:
@POTUS @realDonaldTrump just slammed Australia over our contribution to the Strait of Hormuz:
“I’m not happy with Australia because they were not there when we asked them to be there. Australia is another one. They were not there having to do with Hormuz. So I’m not happy, I’m not happy with them.” (April 16, 2026)

@POTUS made similar remarks in March too, saying he was “very surprised” and “not great” that Australia didn’t send warships.

Fair enough to have the debate.
But let’s remember the actual history of Australia standing shoulder-to-shoulder with American forces in every major conflict since 1918.

It started at the Battle of Hamel, 4 July 1918, the very first time @AustralianArmy and @USArmy fought together on a battlefield, 1,000 US infantry joined Australian brigades in a flawless 93-minute victory on the Western Front. It was called “historic” and the "GI's" and "Diggers" became “blood brothers.”

In WWII after Singapore fell, Australian and American forces again fought side-by-side with the across New Guinea, Coral Sea, Philippines, and Borneo.

In the Korean war, Australia was one of the first militaries to join the US-led @UN force. This birthed the #ANZUS Treaty.

In Vietnam ~60,000 Australians deployed alongside US troops.

In the GWOT, in #Afghanistan and #Iraq: Australia invoked #ANZUS immediately on 9/11, becoming America’s first and one of it's largest non-@NATO contributors during both wars (including #OEF, #OIF, and #OIR)

Currently @USMC Marines rotate through Australia every year and the vital Pine Gap intelligence facility continues to underpin America's intelligence and defence in the southern hemisphere, as well as the #AUKUS submarine pact 

It's a bond forged in blood, renewed in every generation.

The AUS-US alliance isn’t just words, it’s a 108-year record of mateship under fire.

Maybe @SecWar can educate @POTUS on our joint military history and @realDonaldTrump can apologise!
